messages:
ops-bot: [Incident Bulletin] Edge proxy connection pool saturation detected in eu-west-1 and us-west-2 causing delayed streaming starts and transient 502s. Detected 2026-03-22 19:30 UTC. Estimated impact ~3-5% of requests, streaming-heavy tenants hit harder. Mitigations in progress: rolling proxy restarts, LB idle timeout reduction, and a small rate-limiter tweak. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-279012 (internal runbook: https://go/incident/edge-pool-saturation) :rotating_light:

natalie: Oncall: ash. Ash, can we get ETA for full rollout?

ash: Started rolling restarts at 19:35 UTC (proxy:v2.14.3-hotfix2). Progress: eu-west-1 4/10 nodes updated; us-west-2 queued (0/8). Early telemetry on patched nodes: connection backlog down ~40% and socket queue depth dropping. Continuing roll now.

leo: I reduced LB keepalive/idle timeout from 300s -> 60s in eu-west-1 to accelerate cleanup of stale connections. No customer action required.

support-bot: Support queue flagged ~12 customers with heavy streaming error spikes. CS and CSE notified, templated reply prepared.

ash: Noted a slight cold-start latency regression (~+30ms) on patched nodes due to more aggressive socket teardown. We've judged it an acceptable tradeoff given current impact.

maria: Draft customer-facing status (uploaded to draft):
```
We are investigating intermittent increased latency and occasional 502 responses affecting a subset of hosted API requests. Our engineers have identified a connection-exhaustion issue in edge proxies and are deploying a hotfix now. We expect most customers to see restoration within the hour. No customer data loss is expected. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-279012
```

natalie: Maria, please include PS/CSE contact instructions for top-tier customers and flag legal if any contracts are affected.

leo: Telemetry update: overall retry rate for affected tenants peaked at 18% and is down to ~7% on patched nodes. Streaming startup 95th pctl improved from ~1.4s -> ~0.9s where patched.

ops-bot: Postmortem owner assigned: ash. Incident severity: P2. Triage tags: edge-proxy, connection-pool, streaming, lb-config. Next update scheduled in 10 minutes or upon significant change. For escalation ping @natalie. :white_check_mark: 

natalie: Thanks all. Keep updates short and numeric. :thumbsup:
